Mentioning an arbitrary name only creates an [[Identity]] on the fly, and the memory says nothing about it granting that person access to the space.

--- Tag/identity.md ---
identity | description
The `@name` mentions across the space.

--- Recipient.md ---
The Mention Inbox
A **recipient** is an [[Identity]] you address. When mentioned with `@name`, it is indexed to be queried, and clicking it in the editor will open the “Mentions Inbox”.

See [[At-Mention]] for the `@name` syntax, and [[Identity]] for where names come from (accounts, `identity.define`, or simply being mentioned).

--- Guide/Comments, Mentions and Replies.md ---
Add a comment | Send a request
Inside a comment you can use [[At-Mention|at-mentions]]:

```markdown
@reviewer Please check this section. -- @author
```

`@reviewer` addresses the recipient. The trailing `-- @author` credits the writer without addressing them. Use account usernames in a real shared space. Typing an arbitrary name creates an [[Identity]] on the fly.

--- CHANGELOG.md ---
CHANGELOG | Edge > 2.11.0
* **At-mentions and Identities** ([[At-Mention]], [[Identity]]): mention people, teams, or anything else with `@name`. Each name resolves to an [[Identity]] — an account, something registered with `identity.define`, or simply a name you’ve mentioned — addressed by the `@<name:lower>` id, so `@Ada` and `@ada` converge on the same identity. `identity.own()` returns the identity the current user is. An identity is addressed as a [[Recipient]] (→ Mention Inbox) or credited as an author (see [[Authorship]]). (Note: upgrading triggers a full space reindex, since mention identifiers moved to the `@name` form.)
    * **[[Authorship]]**: a trailing `-- @name` (also `— @name`/`– @name`) signs a block instead of addressing it, crediting who wrote it without putting them in anyone’s Mention Inbox. `authors:` frontmatter does the page-level equivalent of `recipients:`. Sign the current block with the `Mention: Sign` command or the `/sign` slash command.

--- Recipient.md ---
The Mention Inbox | Querying mentions
At-mentions are indexed like any other [[Object Index|relation]], with `kind == "at-mention"`. `to` is always the `@name` identifier (`toTag == "identity"`) and `alias` holds the name as typed. Build your own view over them with SLIQ, for example @sam.rivera:

${query[[
  from index.relations "at-mention"
  where _.to == "@sam.rivera"
  select { page = _.page, snippet = _.snippet }
]]}

Frontmatter declarations are relations too, with `kind == "recipients"`.

For a complete request, reply and resolution workflow, see [[Guide/Comments, Mentions and Replies]].
